expectations.text: The close-out carries no guilt, no manufactured deadline pressure, and is not a further touch disguised as a goodbye.
expectations.evidence: The email itself has no guilt; its line "If the timing doesn't work, no problem" is gracious. The only close-out in the answer is Note 3's "Last check before we finalize on the 25th. Should I release the slot?" That is another touch dressed as a goodbye: it asks a question that needs a reply and adds deadline pressure. The advice also sets an earlier reply-by date (the 20th) than the real program close (the 25th), which is a manufactured deadline. There is no clean, no-reply-needed release of the invitation.
